tests.test: Signing WebView entry has no key/password/file parameters
Native signing screen exposes no Javascript interfaces
Password fields are native and masked
Native key/password fields are excluded from saved UI state and autofill
Local signing activity is not externally exported
Private key uses app cache staging rather than project assets or storage
Private original ZIP key extraction remains in native code
Password buffers are wiped after signing
Returned receipt is emitted only after successful save
APK signature name does not disclose owner alias
Public signer receipt does not contain key, password, alias or key paths

scope: Static native/UI boundary inspection of issued source. Host signer execution is reported separately.
limitations: No native Android UI, SAF picker, process-death recovery or physical-device installation was executed.
